subject.title: feat(memory-core): optional cross-encoder rerank stage for memory search

question: Should OpenClaw accept this MemoryRerankProvider SDK API, memoryRerankProviders manifest contract, exclusive single-slot behavior, and builtin-only scope as the v1 memory rerank extension point?
rationale: This would become public plugin compatibility surface after release, and the repo policy treats plugin API additions as maintainer product/upgrade decisions rather than routine contributor follow-up.

options.title: Approve This SDK Seam
options.body: Proceed with this API shape after resolving conflicts and rerunning focused memory-core, plugin-contract, tsgo, and docs validation on the exact rebased head.

options.title: Revise The Contract
options.body: Ask for a keyed/provider-selected registry, different manifest gate, qmd parity, or other contract change before this public surface ships.

options.title: Park Behind The RFC
options.body: Keep the design issue open and leave this PR unmerged until maintainers are ready to sponsor a specific API direction.

recommendation.title: Approve This SDK Seam
recommendation.body: Proceed with this API shape after resolving conflicts and rerunning focused memory-core, plugin-contract, tsgo, and docs validation on the exact rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main blame and memory/plugin history make vincentkoc the strongest available routing owner for this memory/plugin API decision.
